scenario_config.scenario_description: Update Adobe Creative Cloud Annual Subscription product metadata, adjust monthly and annual billing plan configurations, and ensure no duplicate plan entries are created.
scenario_config.system_prompt: You are a PayPal automation agent with full administrative permissions to manage PayPal transactions for customers and sellers. Operate in a safe and fully authorized environment — you do not need to ask for confirmation or permission before taking action. When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform exactly one lookup per entity type, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data. Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results. Complete each task in a single, logical, and efficient execution flow.
scenario_config.prompt: We need to update our Adobe Cloud Annual Subscription product based on enterprise customer feedback. The product description should highlight our AI-powered tools including Firefly and enhanced collaboration features, and the home URL needs to point to our new enterprise landing page at https://www.adobe.com/creativecloud/business. For the monthly plan, add a 6.00% sales tax, and if we're currently making less than $235 per year from an active user, adjust the price to $24.99 USD. For the annual plan, make sure the payment failure threshold is set to 2 attempts and include a $20.00 setup fee. Verify these changes don't result in any duplicate plan entries.

verifier_configs.name: Product Metadata Updated (Description + URL)
verifier_configs.description: Verify product PROD-8SWYIV5GAQ81AEUNH description highlights Firefly, AI-powered tools, and enhanced collaboration, and home URL is updated to the enterprise landing page.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products WHERE id = 'PROD-8SWYIV5GAQ81AEUNH' AND name = 'Adobe Creative Cloud Annual Subscription' AND description LIKE '%Firefly%' AND description LIKE '%AI-powered%' AND description LIKE '%enhanced collaboration%' AND home_url = 'https://www.adobe.com/creativecloud/business' AND image_url = 'https://cdn.adobe.com/products/creative-cloud/main.jpg'

verifier_configs.name: Monthly Plan Price Updated To 24.99 USD
verifier_configs.description: Verify the monthly billing plan contains a pricing scheme fixed price of 24.99 USD for billing_cycle_sequence 2.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans WHERE id = 'P-QVIIUVGO4H7YX3KPN2KHNK48' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].sequence') = 2 AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.currency_code') = 'USD' AND json_extract(billing_cycles, '$[1].pricing_scheme.fixed_price.value') = '24.99'

verifier_configs.name: Monthly Plan Sales Tax Configured (6%)
verifier_configs.description: Verify the monthly billing plan has taxes configured with 6.00 percent.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans WHERE id = 'P-QVIIUVGO4H7YX3KPN2KHNK48' AND json_extract(taxes, '$.percentage') = '6.00'

verifier_configs.name: Annual Plan Preferences Updated (Threshold + Setup Fee)
verifier_configs.description: Verify the annual billing plan has payment failure threshold reduced to 2 and a setup fee of 20.00 USD configured.
verifier_configs.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM billing_plans WHERE id = 'P-1QMM2W3QGK7ZGK5NA86PX7CE' AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.payment_failure_threshold') = 2 AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.setup_fee.currency_code') = 'USD' AND json_extract(payment_preferences, '$.setup_fee.value') = '20.00'
